changes.text: @giskard09, thanks — yes, please open it as an issue on agent-payment-chain. To build the bundle we need the network, the settlement transaction hash, and the payment payload the client sent (the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header in x402 v2, `X-PAYMENT` in v1, or its decoded JSON). The facilitator's reply is optional: it is reported apart (`facilitator_reply`) and never raises the level. @osr21 Right, and it's a real gap — `anchor_inclusion_verified=True` was only ever "found a success receipt," never finality, but nothing said so.
